The 00928AB4 branch (entity+C0h with kind 3) is unread. docs/MISSION_LUA_SELF_TABLE.md. | Correction and completion (cc2_entity_lua_attach): 00928A00 is not reached only from 0077E830. It IS entity virtual slot 39 (+9Ch) of the root entity vtable 00CE6290, and 0077E830 is a derived override of the same slot that calls it directly at 0077E834. 43 vtables install a slot-39 attach: this one, 17 that take 0077E830 unchanged, and 25 behind the nine further overrides (004426C0 006D0C80 00743450 00743E90 0074CCF0 007CDF20 007F4580 00810F60 008429E0), so 21 named vehicle classes from docs/VEHICLE_CLASS_DESCRIPTORS.md all reach it.
